title: Research: one dirty role does not lower SL2(F3) conjugate-triple minimum (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers the dirty-role open question of [`research/sl2f3-conjugate-triple-seed592f`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/sl2f3-conjugate-triple-seed592f) / [#2010](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2010): does one restored dirty scalar role lower the five-call minimum for the same SL2(F3) endpoint?

**No.** On `M₄(F₂[SL2(F₃)])` with target `diag([i],[w],[c],[e])` (`c = w⁻¹ i w`), paid labels `{i,i⁻¹,w,w⁻¹}`, and all **120** rank-one idempotents of `M₄(F₂)` (**480** factors):

- The predecessor three-role five-call word extends verbatim (identity on the dirty role) and attains the target.
- Exact meet-in-the-middle through length 4 (`1+2` / `2+2`; complete two-call table **230400** words, **165261** distinct states) finds **0** hits.
- Therefore the paid-call minimum remains exactly **5**; one restored dirty scalar does not lower it.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. Does not claim two-or-more dirty roles, a BIT supplier, or a physical address-operation invoice.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four/`
- Tip: `2ea94939fc9dc9f910bc8247a05d762734c0a56d`
- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`
- Scope: **refined** — four-role dirty census answering the predecessor dirty-role OQ for one dirty role

Closest prior: `sl2f3-conjugate-triple-seed592f` / [#2010](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2010) (three-role five-call minimum). Soft overlap ≈0.35–0.55 (shared group/generators; new 4-role/480-factor MITM + frozenset independent engine).

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SL2F3_DIRTY_ROLE_FOUR group=24 roles=4 calls=480 idempotents=120 target_minimum=5 pair_words=230400 distinct_pair_states=165261 dirty_lowers=false short_witness=none no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_SL2F3_DIRTY_ROLE_FOUR group=24 roles=4 calls=480 target_minimum=5 distinct_pair_states=165261 dirty_lowers=false no_new_kappa
PASS_SL2F3_DIRTY_ROLE_FOUR_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=4
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/sl2f3-dirty-role-four outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. Full verify is slow (minutes).

## Open next questions / limitations

1. Do two or more restored dirty scalar roles lower the five-call minimum for this same SL2(F3) endpoint?
2. Is there a priced native address-operation realization of this SL2(F3) alphabet inside an admitted BIT supplier?
